This Privacy Policy explains how SleepCore Companion App collects, uses, and protects your health data from Health Connect. This policy applies to all users of the SleepCore digital therapeutic platform for insomnia treatment.
The data controller is Charitable Foundation \"Another Way\" (BF \"Drugoy Put\"), registered in the Russian Federation.\n\nContact: privacy@sleepcore.ru
Sleep Sessions: duration, start/end times, sleep stages (REM, deep, light, awake)
Heart Rate Variability (HRV): RMSSD measurements for sleep quality assessment
Heart Rate: average heart rate during sleep periods
Resting Heart Rate: daily baseline measurements
Blood Oxygen (SpO2): oxygen saturation levels during sleep
Respiratory Rate: breathing patterns and potential disturbances
Provide personalized CBT-I (Cognitive Behavioral Therapy for Insomnia) recommendations
Track your sleep improvement progress over the therapy course
Calculate sleep efficiency, total sleep time, and other clinical metrics
Identify patterns and factors affecting your sleep quality
Screen for potential sleep breathing disorders using SpO2 and respiratory data
Monitor circadian rhythm indicators via temperature patterns

We process your health data based on your explicit consent (GDPR Article 9.2.a). You provide this consent when you grant Health Connect permissions and link your device to SleepCore.\n\nYou may withdraw your consent at any time by unlinking your device or revoking Health Connect permissions.

Your health data is retained for the duration of your therapy program plus 6 years for medical record compliance (FDA 21 CFR Part 11, HIPAA).\n\nWhen you unlink your device, your data is marked for deletion and permanently erased within 30 days, unless retention is required by law.
All data is encrypted in transit using TLS 1.3
Data at rest is encrypted using AES-256-GCM
We never sell or share your data with third parties for marketing

Your data may be processed on servers located in the European Union and/or Russian Federation. We ensure appropriate safeguards are in place for any international transfers in accordance with applicable data protection laws.
Access: Request a copy of all data we hold about you
Rectification: Request correction of inaccurate data
Erasure: Request deletion of your data (\"right to be forgotten\")
Portability: Receive your data in a machine-readable format
Withdraw Consent: Revoke permissions at any time via device settings
Complaint: Lodge a complaint with your local data protection authority

To exercise any of these rights:

1. Unlink Device: Settings in this app to immediately stop data collection
2. Revoke Permissions: Android Settings → Health Connect → SleepCore
3. Data Request: Email privacy@sleepcore.ru with your request

We will respond to your request within 30 days.
